ocr_samples: あなたが貰ったのならあなたが飲めばいいじゃない!
体に良いらしいわよ私は飲んだこと無いけど
他の妖怪達もそれくらい平和な考えだとうれしいんだけどね
ところでこのお茶不思議な味がするのね
え...なにそれ飲んでも大丈夫なのよね?
ああそれ魔理沙が作った紅茶キノコよ
translations: If it’s something you’ve received, then you can drink it, right?
It seems to be good for the body. I’ve never tried it before.
I’m glad that other monsters also think it’s a peaceful idea.
No, I don’t want such a suspicious thing!!
By the way, this tea has a strange taste.
Eh… does it really not hurt to drink it?
Ah, that’s a tea mushroom created by Morisaka.
